labels.secretSet: A key is set — leave empty to keep it
labels.notReady: Not set up (provider off or no key)
labels.moduleOffAdmin: The chat is switched OFF. Tick “Chat enabled” below and save.
labels.bookingLink: Booking page (the chat is embedded here)
labels.bookingOffHint: The “Online booking” module is off: the chat can answer questions but cannot book.
labels.testHint: Sends one short request (a fraction of a cent) and shows the result.
labels.privacyHint: Visitors' phone numbers and e-mails never reach the model or the journal: they are replaced by placeholders and the real value is kept for 24 hours only to complete a booking. The chat has no tool that reads customers, orders, revenue or staff.
labels.legalHint: Before switching on: tell visitors they talk to an AI (the widget does), a data-processing agreement with the provider, an entry in your processing register. See docs/CLIENT_ASSISTANT.md.
labels.keyHint: The API key is shared with the staff assistant (write-only, kept in data/config-internal.php).
labels.knowledgeNote: This is exactly what the chat may state as fact. Hours come from Online booking, prices from the service list, address from Brand unless overridden below.
labels.title: Customer chat (AI)

fields.clientAssistantFaq: Frequently asked questions and house rules

hints.clientAssistantEnabled: Off by default. When on, the chat appears on /booking/ and at /booking/chat/ — only if a provider and key are set.
hints.clientAssistantProvider: Off: the chat answers “unavailable” and nothing is sent anywhere.
hints.assistantApiKey: Write-only. Shared with the staff assistant.
hints.clientAssistantModel: Default claude-haiku-5-5 (cheap, enough for questions and bookings).
hints.clientAssistantPhone: Shown to visitors and offered when the chat does not know. Digits and +.
hints.clientAssistantPayments: E.g. “Cash and cards at the desk; companies by invoice”. Empty = the chat says it does not know.
hints.clientAssistantFaq: One fact per line. The chat answers ONLY from this text, the price list and the hours. E.g. “Dogs may wait in the lounge on a leash.”
hints.clientAssistantMonthBudgetEur: Once this month's estimated cost reaches it the chat stops (hard ceiling 1000).
hints.clientAssistantRetentionDays: At least 31 days (the limits are summed from the journal). Cleanup: bin/command client-assistant-purge and the daily job.
